title: An entry marked as exported by hand is still reversed on Reopen
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location is connected to QuickBooks Online, with Inventory Asset and Cost of Parts mapped on its ShopView Accounts page, and that AccountingHub is not enabled.
  • Have access to the QuickBooks Online company of the test location, so its journal entries can be read.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed, with one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2, whose Close entry was Marked as Exported in QB Unexported.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Open the invoice menu on the Finance tab.
  4. Click "Reopen Work Order".
  5. Click Reopen Work Order in the window.
  6. In QuickBooks Online, open the journal entries for work order 1's number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The document shows.

Step 3:

  • The menu offers "Reopen Work Order".

Step 4:

  • The window opens.

Step 5:

  • The status reads "Complete".

Step 6:

  • A reversing entry "Reopened [number]" for $80.00 is in QuickBooks.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11761 (Story 4, Reopen a closed internal or no-charge work order), story SV-11764 (Story 7, QuickBooks Online sync)

  • S7-E2: “If an entry in QB Unexported is Marked as Exported by hand and the work order is later reopened, the reversal is still sent, so the books stay symmetrical; the accountant deletes the manual entry.”
  • S4-E1: “If the Close entry is still held in AccountingHub, Reopen withdraws it instead of posting a reversal; the row stays on Accounting Events with the status Dismissed and the reason "Withdrawn: work order reopened" (nothing was posted, so nothing is reversed). In QuickBooks, Reopen reverses only what was posted at Close, to the same accounts (S7-R5): an entry posted to the mapped account or to ShopView Review gets its reversal; an entry never sent (S7-N5) gets none; an entry still waiting in QB Unexported gets none, and its row is marked "Withdrawn: work order reopened". An entry Marked as Exported by hand counts as posted (S7-E2).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
